verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party line saying LangSmith Engine automatically detects recurring issues in traces, diagnoses their root cause, and resolves them. That is a built-in agentic capability, but it is narrowly scoped to trace issues and is not described as an assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose in-product assistant or chat interface for delegating tasks, details on what Engine can actually do and how users invoke it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
